name: robust_regression_v1
author: claude_strategist
mechanism: On NIFTY, institutional TWAP and VWAP algorithms executing large directional orders create persistent micro-trends over 3-7 minute windows. Individual block trades and sudden micro-news events generate outlier bars that bias OLS regression and obscure the genuine institutional flow direction; Huber IRLS down-weights these spike bars (residual > 1.35 * MAD) to reveal the true gradient of underlying demand. When the Huber slope t-statistic exceeds 2.0 on a 5-minute window (60 bars) and price dips back below the regression line, we are entering a confirmed TWAP buy-flow at a momentary intraday imbalance point — the ongoing order execution will absorb that imbalance and push spot back through the trend line within 30-90 seconds.

indicators.name: huber_t_stat
indicators.formula: slope / se(slope) from IRLS-Huber WLS regression of close on bar_index (window=60 bars)
indicators.purpose: 60-bar window (5 minutes) chosen because: (a) <30 bars yields t-stat with too few degrees of freedom; (b) 5 min captures one round of institutional TWAP activity on NIFTY and gives a stable slope estimate; (c) longer windows (120+ bars) would lag too far behind for 15-120 second options trades. This is NOT 12x the original 30-min window — original 30 bars at 1-min = 30 min, but we need 5-min because we hold 15-120 seconds, not 15-45 minutes. Threshold 2.0 ensures >95% confidence the slope is non-zero.

indicators.name: huber_residual
indicators.formula: close[i] - (huber_intercept + huber_slope * (window-1)) — distance from regression line at current bar
indicators.purpose: Negative residual means price is below the robust trend line — the dip-entry opportunity in an uptrend. Entry requires residual in [-2*MAD, 0) to catch genuine dips while excluding extreme outlier bars that the Huber weighting itself classifies as statistical anomalies.

indicators.name: huber_residual_mad
indicators.formula: MAD(residuals_in_window) * 1.4826 (robust standard deviation) from final IRLS iteration
indicators.purpose: Noise-level denominator for normalising the residual — ensures dip entry is meaningful relative to the scatter of the current trend window, not an arbitrary threshold.

indicators.name: vwap
indicators.formula: cumsum(close * volume) / cumsum(volume), reset each session
indicators.purpose: Session trend filter. close > VWAP for CE entries confirms that TWAP institutional buyers are net above their benchmark — they will continue buying. Unchanged from original strategy which used VWAP as a broad direction filter.

conditions: huber_t_stat > t_stat_threshold (robust uptrend statistically significant, default 2.0)
huber_residual < 0 (price is below robust regression line — dip in confirmed uptrend)
huber_residual > -mad_limit * huber_residual_mad (not an extreme outlier, default mad_limit=2.0)
close > vwap (session trend: TWAP buyers are above benchmark, demand intact)
India VIX < 25 (original filter preserved; high VIX creates spike-dominated bars)
buy_ce.confirmation: none — signals fire immediately on bar close; time_stop handles false positives

conditions: huber_residual > 0 (price is above regression line — rip in confirmed downtrend)

exit.stop_rationale: 4 option pts (~8 NIFTY spot pts at delta 0.5): if NIFTY moves 8 spot pts against a confirmed robust uptrend within 30 seconds, the institutional flow has stalled or reversed and the TWAP thesis is invalid; 4 pts is just above the upper end of typical 30s adverse NIFTY moves (2-5 pts) to avoid noise-stops while still cutting losers promptly.
exit.target_rationale: 7 option pts (~14 NIFTY spot pts): a confirmed institutional TWAP trend with t-stat > 2.0 should carry NIFTY at least 14 spot pts in the next 60-120 seconds — the lower bound of 1-min typical NIFTY moves (3-7 option pts); 1:1.75 R:R calibrated so 55% win rate exceeds break-even at ~0.6 pts cost.

filters.vix_filter: India VIX < 25 — inherited from original; extreme vol regimes create spike-heavy bars that saturate Huber weights and degrade regression quality
filters.time_filter: No entries before 09:25 IST — need 60 bars (5 min) warmup for stable regression from 09:15 open
filters.volume_filter: none — NIFTY index volume is noisy at 5-second resolution; VWAP provides implicit volume-weighting
filters.trend_filter: VWAP direction: close > vwap for CE, close < vwap for PE

edge.edge_decay_risk: Low-Medium — Huber regression filtering is a principled statistical technique; the edge stems from cleaner trend detection not from a specific market pattern that participants would immediately arbitrage away

adaptation_notes: Original traded NIFTY 50 constituent stocks on 1-min bars with 15-45 min hold using sklearn HuberRegressor. Key changes: (1) Applied to NIFTY index directly — no stock universe needed; (2) Window compressed from 30 bars (30 min) to 60 bars (5 min) — we're trading the fast institutional flow, not the slow multi-stock trend; (3) Replaced sklearn HuberRegressor with numpy IRLS for pipeline compatibility and performance; (4) Target changed from 'residual crosses zero' to a fixed option-point target since option premium dynamics don't mirror the regression line crossing; (5) Stop changed from residual-based to fixed option-point stop; (6) VIX < 25 filter preserved; earnings/stock-specific filters dropped. The core insight — outlier-resistant trend slope is more reliable than OLS — translates directly to NIFTY where individual TWAP spikes regularly distort simple moving average slopes.
weaknesses: IRLS loop is O(n * window * iterations) per compute() call — slow for large datasets but acceptable for per-day evaluation
At 5-second resolution, 60-bar t-stat may generate more false positives than at 1-minute because intraday NIFTY is noisier; t_stat_threshold may need to be raised to 2.5+
Dip-in-trend + t-stat + VWAP three-way conjunction may produce too few signals on slow range-bound days

_source.original_target: Residual crosses zero (price returns to regression line)
